meta.name: deer-flow
meta.description: An open-source long-horizon SuperAgent harness that researches, codes, and creates. With the help of sandboxes, memories, tools, skill, subagents and message gateway, it handles different levels of tasks that could take minutes to hours.

install.title: Quick Start
install.html:
git clone https://github.com/bytedance/deer-flow.git
cd deer-flow
make setup          # interactive wizard: writes config.yaml and .env (about 2 minutes)

Then start DeerFlow with Docker (recommended) or run it locally:

# Docker
make docker-init    # pull the sandbox image (once, or when the image updates)
make docker-start   # start services

# Local development
make check          # verifies Node.js 22+, pnpm, uv, nginx
make install
make dev

The local commands use the pnpm version pinned in frontend/package.json. If a different global pnpm is on PATH, they use Corepack when available; otherwise they report the version mismatch before installing frontend dependencies.

Run make doctor after setting model credentials. It reports obvious placeholder API keys as incomplete configuration; replace them with real keys before testing model calls.

Open http://localhost:2026.

  • All configuration options, providers and manual setup: Configuration
  • Docker details, sizing, upgrades, startup modes and production deployment: Running the Application
  • Running on a server or exposing it beyond localhost: read the Security Notice first
